_doc: The S2 frame witness for Add Anchor Point (transform-correct path verbs). The open path (0,0) -> (30,30) -> (60,0) sits inside a group with the NON-UNIFORM matrix (2,0,0,3,60,30) in pt, so its first segment is DRAWN from (60,30) to (120,120). A click on it at the drawn midpoint (90,75) inserts one anchor at t = 0.5, local (15,15); the old walker searched the local segment for the document-space click and missed it.
name: add_anchor_point_in_scaled_group
